newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Dutch company results due Jan 13.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dutch company results due Jan 13.

text.p: Analysts' estimates of Dutch company results for week beginning Monday, Jan 13 include:
Profit figures are net profits before extraordinary items and in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated.

Securities houses surveyed included: Amstgeld, Bangert Pontier, BZW, Delta Lloyd Bank, Generale Bank, Gilissen, ING Bank, Kempen & Co, Lanschot Bankiers, Mees Pierson, NIB Strating, Wesselius and Wijs & Van Oostveen.
NOTE - Banks and brokers interested in contributing to Reuters surveys can contact the Amsterdam newsroom on +31-20-504-5000 or fax their forecasts to +31-20-504 5040.
For the week starting January 20 we are collecting year result forecast for ASM Litho.
